summary: United Microelectronics Corp (UMC) filed a Form 6-K under cover of an exhibit announcing that its subsidiary Fortune Venture Capital Corporation disposed of 3,706,000 common shares of Taiwan Semiconductor Co., Ltd. between 2026/01/23 and 2026/07/15 at an average price of NTD 81.63 per share (total proceeds ~NTD 302.5M). The transaction resulted in a gain of NTD 137.6M and was described as a 'financing operation' with no board resolution date provided. Post-disposal, Fortune retains 3,035,000 shares (1.15% stake). This is purely an ordinary portfolio rebalancing by a subsidiary, not a corporate restructuring, divestiture, or special situation. The 6-K is a routine filing of a non-material securities disposal.
